name: Suspicious Web Activity
description: The Suspicious Web Activity dashboard shows suspicious activity on the Web. It shows suspicious blocked requests, including by trend and geo location.
title: Suspicious Web Activity

panels.title: Suspicious Blocked Web Requests by Location

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/AWS/WAF 
| json "httpRequest.httpMethod","httpRequest.httpVersion","httpRequest.uri","httpRequest.clientIp","httpRequest.country","action","matchingNonTerminatingRules","rateBasedRuleList","ruleGroupList","httpSourceId","httpSourceName","terminatingRuleType","terminatingRuleId","webaclId" as http_method,http_version,url.path,client.ip,country,action,matching_non_terminating_rules,rate_based_rule_list,rule_group_list,http_source_id,http_source_name,terminating_rule_type,terminating_rule_id,webacl_id nodrop
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client.ip

| http_method as event.action
| action as event.outcome

// global filters
| where if ("{{url.path}}" = "*", true, url.path matches "{{url.path}}") AND if ("{{client.ip}}" = "*", true, client.ip matches "{{client.ip}}") AND if ("{{event.action}}" = "*", true, event.action matches "{{event.action}}") AND if ("{{event.outcome}}" = "*", true, event.outcome matches "{{event.outcome}}")

// z-score calculation
| timeslice 3h
| if(event.outcome="BLOCK",1,0) as Blocked_count
| if(event.outcome="ALLOW",1,0) as Allowed_count
|sum(Blocked_count) as blocked, sum(Allowed_count) as allowed by _timeslice, client.ip,url.path, terminating_rule_type,terminating_rule_id,event.action,http_source_id,http_source_name, latitude, longitude, country_code
| (blocked + allowed) as requests
| if(requests > 0, blocked/requests, 0) as blocked_pct
| blocked_pct as eventCount
| sort + _timeslice

| rollingstd eventCount as eventCount_std by client.ip,url.path,event.action,http_source_id,http_source_name, latitude, longitude, country_code
| smooth eventCount as eventCount_mean by client.ip,url.path,event.action,http_source_id,http_source_name, latitude, longitude, country_code
| eventCount_std + 0.1 as eventCount_std
| (eventCount - eventCount_mean) / eventCount_std as zscore
| sort + _timeslice

| max(zscore) as max_zscore by client.ip,url.path,event.action,http_source_id,http_source_name, latitude, longitude, country_code
| round(max_zscore, 2) as max_zscore 
| where max_zscore > "{{risk.calculated_level}}"
| sort - max_zscore

| count as event_location by latitude, longitude
| sort by event_location

panels.description: Shows the geo-locations of WAF hits.
